verdicts.reason: A has a clean vertical stack: headline, then the phone inside its circle, then the badge and CTA, with even spacing. But the supporting copy now sits below the CTA, which breaks the reading order. It is also oversized, wraps into four ragged lines and is left-aligned against otherwise centred elements. In B the phone is blown up so far that it beats the headline as the focal point. Its cream circle is cut off awkwardly by both canvas edges, and the badge, CTA and fine-print subcopy are crammed into the bottom third with the copy almost touching the bottom edge.
